The name Amitesh carries the meaning “Immeasurable, Infinite” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Amitesh usually hope their child will grow to embody immeasurable, infinite and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name 'Amitesh' holds significant cultural importance in Hindu society, as it is the name of various deities and entities within Hindu mythology. For instance, Lord Amiteshvara is revered as the Lord of the infinite universe. This idea is further reinforced by the names of other Hindu goddesses like Amiteshwari, Amriteshwari, and Amitabha, all of which signify the infinite and unchanging nature of the divine. Moreover, the name is also commonly used in various rituals and ceremonies, symbolizing a deep connection with Hindu spiritual roots.
data.spiritual_significance: S spiritually, the name 'Amitesh' represents the infinite and unchanging nature of the divine. The prefix 'Ami' signifies the boundless and endless qualities of God, while the suffix 'Tesh' refers to the divine and godly aspect of the name. The name thus embodies the timeless and infinite nature of the divine and serves as a powerful reminder of the spiritual truths that transcend the bounds of space, time, and personal experience. The name also carries the vibration of the divine presence, evoking feelings of awe, reverence, and connection with the eternal and infinite existence.
